## Young Cuélebre (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
CE Large dragon  
**Init** +5; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +18  


**Defense**


**AC** 22, touch 10, flat-footed 21 (+1 Dex, +12 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 216 (12d12+72)  
**Fort** +14, **Ref** +11, **Will** +13  
**Immune** paralysis, sleep  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** bite +20 (2d6+12/19–20), tail slap +19 (1d8+12 plus grab), 2 wings +17 (1d8+4)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite and tail slap)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (40-ft. cone, 6d6 acid, DC 22), constrict (1d8+12, tail slap)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 27, **Dex** 12, **Con** 23, **Int** 14, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +21 (+25 grapple); **CMD** 32 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Weapon Focus (bite)  
**Skills** Climb +23, Fly +10, Intimidate +18, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +12, Survival +18, Swim +23  
**Languages** Common, Draconic
